subject: Mutual action plan and timeline — hosting lane & regional preference
preview: MAP + timeline for Cortex Health: propose Dedicated PoC in us-east-1, acceptance gates (SOC2 evidence, KMS), fallback hosted option, next steps and deliverables.
messages:
From: Alex Kim <alex@cortexhealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@cortexhealth.com, legal@cortexhealth.com
Date: 2027-04-18T09:12:01-07:00
Subject: Mutual Action Plan: deployment path & region considerations

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for running through Redwood's capabilities in yesterday's call. We're starting to draft a mutual action plan (MAP) to align our engineering, security, and procurement teams on a deployment approach for Cortex Health's inference needs (PHI-bearing clinical summarization). A few constraints from our side:

- Data residency: must keep PHI-hosted in US-only region; our security lead prefers an isolated VPC or dedicated tenancy.
- Latency: target 120ms median p95 for single-turn summaries in US-EAST workloads.
- Auditability: we need ingest/audit logs and evidence of SOC2 controls for the model-serving plane.

Could you share a draft MAP and an evaluation plan that compares Hosted / Dedicated / Private with concrete acceptance gates and high-level cost delta? Procurement would like a 6–8 week close timeline if possible. I've attached our retention & regulatory note for context.

Appreciate it — let me know who from your side should own the MAP and whether you can map a tight timeline.

Best,
Alex Kim
Head of Engineering, Cortex Health
Attach: Cortex_Retention_Reqs.pdf
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Alex Kim <alex@cortexhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-20T15:03:45-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan: deployment path & region considerations

Alex — thanks for the clear constraints and the retention doc. Attaching a working MAP draft that lays out a 4-week evaluation cadence plus a proposed 4-week cutover to Dedicated if the PoC meets gates. High-level notes below and suggested next steps.

Quick summary (first-pass):
- Proposed PoC lane: Dedicated (us-east-1) with canary traffic from Hosted for failover. Rationale: predictable throughput and VPC isolation meet procurement/security needs while keeping a Hosted fallback for continuity.
- Acceptance gates: SOC2 report or SOC2-derived evidence for the runtime; KMS integration for customer-managed keys; traffic/latency verification (p95 <= 140ms for starter seed); regression checks on 500-case prompt set.
- Evaluation phases:
  1) Week 0–1: infra setup (VPC peering, KMS test key, access matrix)
  2) Week 2–3: load & latency testing + quality evals (red-team prompts)
  3) Week 4: final acceptance & cutover planning (rollout window)

Questions for Cortex:
- Is your security team open to a Dedicated pool inside your VPC (Redwood-managed instances) vs fully Private (customer-managed nodes)? We can map cost & timeline deltas once we know preference.
- Procurement: what is Cortex's approval SLA for a contract redline? We want to align the MAP's close milestone with your procurement cadence.

Next steps — can we do a 30-min working session with your security + procurement next Tue (Apr 27) to triage the risk areas? I'll also include Karthik (hosting/routing) and Laura (partner ops) to the session.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Enterprise Solutions — Redwood Inference
Mobile: (415) 555-0146
Attach: Redwood_MAP_draft.xlsx
From: Alex Kim <alex@cortexhealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@cortexhealth.com, legal@cortexhealth.com
Date: 2027-04-22T10:21:12-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan: deployment path & region considerations

Tessa — thanks for the fast turnaround. A couple of clarifications from our side after an internal huddle:

- Security's default preference is Private (on-prem or customer-hosted nodes) when PHI is involved, but they said Dedicated in a customer VPC with strict KMS controls could be acceptable provided we get SOC2 runtime evidence and a full network diagram.
- Procurement notes: standard approval SLA is ~10 business days for commercial redlines; legal will prioritize once we have a single version of the MAP + contract redlines attached to the HubSpot deal.
- Latency: we may need to tighten p95 to <= 130ms for some live workflows; can you flag estimated risk/cost delta to hit that target on Dedicated vs Hosted?

We also attached a short set of security questions. If you can map Dedicated vs Private timeline and cost delta (ballpark), procurement can decide whether to push for Dedicated now or insist on Private.

—Alex
Attach: security_questions.docx

Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan: deployment path & region considerations — MAP v2 and timeline

Alex — looping back with a revised MAP and a concrete close timeline that aligns with your procurement SLA. Key points below; full MAP attached (v2).

Top-line recommendation:
- Short-term PoC lane: Dedicated (us-east-1) inside a Cortex-managed VPC with Redwood-managed Dedicated GPU pool. This balances your security ask and procurement urgency. If security gating requires Private, we’ll convert the MAP to a Private plan (longer lead time).

Revised timeline (aligned to your ~10 business-day contract SLA):
- Week 0 (now): Finalize MAP + sign off on PoC scope (Cortex security + procurement review)
- Week 1: Infra onboarding — VPC peering, KMS staging, initial SOC2 evidence packet delivery (runtime vendor attestation + SOC2 excerpt)
- Week 2: Load & latency testing (target p95 <= 130ms). Redwood to provide batch of synthetic loads and a detailed perf plan.
- Week 3: Quality & regression evals against Cortex's 500-case set; finalize redlines and run a short canary (10% traffic) into Dedicated pool.
- Week 4: Cutover planning + contract sign (DocuSign link below). If cutover is green, schedule full ramp in the following maintenance window.

Acceptance gates (must pass all):
- SOC2 runtime evidence received and reviewed;
- KMS integration test logged successfully;
- p95 latency verified <= 130ms on agreed test harness;
- No high-severity regression on the 500-case prompt set.

Deliverables from Redwood this week:
- MAP v2 (attached)
- Cost delta: provisional estimate for Dedicated vs Hosted for your expected 1.2M tokens/mo (attached sheet)
- HubSpot note + single source of truth: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234566/deal/CH-2027-1023

DocuSign for the PO/contract: https://www.docusign.com/en/inbox/CH-2027-1023

Next steps: Can we lock a 30-min working call Thu Apr 29 11:00am ET to run security & procurement through the MAP? If yes, I'll send the calendar invite and invite Karthik and Laura.

Thanks — excited to get this moving.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Enterprise Solutions — Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0100 | M: (415) 555-0146
Attach: 20270426-Cortex_MAP_v2.xlsx
